AI Visual Novel Maker

AI visual novel maker
for stories you can play

Describe the setup. MangoBox builds the cast, scenes, and conversation.

Start your story

How it works

01

Write the setup

Who you are, who else is there, and where it takes place. One sentence works; more detail gives you more control.

02

MangoBox builds it

Character portraits, locations, personalities, and an opening scene.

03

Play it out

Talk to the cast, make choices, and generate new scenes as the story goes.

What you get

Up to five characters

Each with their own personality, goals, and visual style.

Portrait and scene art

Generate images in anime, cyberpunk, realistic, and other styles.

Group conversations

Characters respond to you and to each other, including interruptions and side conversations.

Chats stay in your browser

MangoBox does not store or log them on its servers.

Playable in minutes

A written setup becomes a story you can play, with no assets to build by hand.

Replayable

Start again from the same setup and take different choices.

Pro

Higher limits

  • Unlimited stories and image visualizations
  • 20 generated videos per month
  • Unlimited chats and messages
  • High-resolution realistic and anime styles
  • Early access to new features
